title: Agilent Cary 60 Spectrophotometer User’s Guide
locator: Chapter 5, Instrument Performance Testing and Wavelength Calibration, pp. 33–34.
summary: Cary WinUV shows the instrument calibration status in System Information. The guide directs users to the Validate performance tests and explains what to check when a spectral peak shifts.
scope: These pages cover instrument performance. The lab must establish the calibration curve and conditions for its analyte separately.

title: GENESYS Family Spectrophotometers User Guide
locator: Model list, p. 1. Chapter 2, Quant Application, pp. 47–48.
summary: The Quant application records known standard concentrations and the chosen curve type. After the standards are measured, it displays the fitted equation and R² and enables sample measurement.
scope: This guide covers multiple models. Consult the model list for hardware options and use a separate assay source for the wavelength and standards.

title: GENESYS 10S UV-Vis User Guide
locator: Chapter 19, Concentration Measurements—Standard Curve Application, pp. 83–85.
summary: The Standard Curve application measures known standards, fits a calibration curve and uses it to estimate sample concentration. The operator sets the wavelength, curve fit, units and number of standards.
scope: Applies to the GENESYS 10S UV-Vis. Selection of an analyte-specific method and sample preparation requires separate evidence.

title: UV/VIS Excellence UV7/UV5/UV5Bio User Manual
locator: Model and firmware coverage, p. 3. Sections 5.4.2 and 5.4.5, pp. 21–22 and 24–25.
summary: The fixed-wavelength mode records a blank and sample. In Quant mode the operator defines standards and measures them before evaluating samples.
scope: For UV7, UV5 and UV5Bio running firmware 2.0 or higher. Method availability differs by model. Consult the experiment source for analyte-specific settings.

title: UV/VIS Excellence UV5Nano User Manual
locator: Model and firmware coverage, p. 3. Sections 5.2 and 5.3.1, pp. 14–17. Section 5.3.3, p. 19.
summary: The guide distinguishes cuvette and microvolume measurements. It describes measuring a blank and a sample at a selected wavelength, plus a Quant mode with standards.
scope: For the UV5Nano running firmware 2.0 or higher. Record the sample holder and optical path when comparing results across configurations.

title: ME Precision and Analytical Balances Operating Instructions
locator: Sections 4.6.2 and 4.8, pp. 16 and 18–19. Section 4.9, p. 21. Section 10.2.1, pp. 62–63.
summary: The manual explains leveling, adjustment and taring. Its analytical balance tables identify internal or external adjustment for each model and list weights for routine tests.
scope: Use the table for the exact model and suffix. The suitability of a test weight and acceptance limits for the lab’s weighing process need separate evidence.

title: Orion Star A210 Series Electrochemistry Benchtop Meters User Manual
locator: Meter models and measurement capabilities, p. 19. Chapter 4, pH calibration, pp. 51–52, and conductivity calibration, pp. 59–60.
summary: The guide describes pH buffer calibration for A211, A214, A215 and A216. For A212 and A215 it describes calibrating with conductivity standards or entering a certified cell constant.
scope: Choose the instructions for the meter’s channel and connected sensor. The lab’s water method determines sampling conditions, check standards and acceptance criteria.
